feature_name: Rolldown Filter Integration for Vite Plugins
description: Replace JavaScript-based conditional logic in Vite plugins with rolldown's native filter system to improve build performance. This change should move filtering logic from JavaScript to Rust, reducing overhead and making the build process more efficient.
functional_requirements: Replace if statements and manual filtering in Vite plugins with rolldown's filter API
Ensure all existing plugin functionality is preserved after migrating to filter-based logic
Maintain compatibility with existing test suite and manual testing workflows
Apply the filter optimization consistently across all affected Vite plugins in the codebase
